note: Approved render-environment classes for the Blender lane, and the pinned tolerances (docs/BLENDER.md, Determinism). Kept apart from config/blender.json so that approving a class never changes the render config hash a class is defined by. Each class pins the Blender build it was qualified on, which must equal config/blender.json's pin or the class approves nothing, and the GPU backend Blender reported (docs/PUBLICATION.md). Same class: lossless frames byte-identical. Different approved classes: bounded equivalence (character crops and full-scene frames separately). A crop sequence against its full-frame reference: bounded equivalence of the final 1920x1080 composites. Each limit was set on 2026-10-18 as the worst value then measured times a margin, and is unchanged; `measured` records the worst value on the current baseline (2026-10-19: the material pass, rig v6), so the remaining headroom is visible.
